scope: Market document cache ownership, configured-source URL admission and replacement
implementation: Carries unchanged normalizeIndexUrl and shared RemoteError implementation in the private worker; canonical key comparison retains configured invalid spellings while detecting equivalent new duplicates.

MarketDocumentCache uses an injected validated-index fetch and live URL getter. Concurrent readers share a task; caller cancellation withdraws only its wait. Cached titles/errors, strict TTL boundary, pinned expired pages and monotonic per-URL fetch identifiers match Source.
Volatile reconciliation drops removed/unusable cache and error facts. Finishing removed fetches do not restore facts. Disposal aborts the provider lifetime and waits for owned fetch settlement.
